ValidationRule.description: Validation to check New to Bank when creating or updating a lead.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( (ISCHANGED( New_to_Bank__c ) || ISCHANGED( FinServ__RelatedAccount__c ) || ISNEW()), $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', NOT ISBLANK( FinServ__RelatedAccount__c ) , TEXT( New_to_Bank__c ) = "Yes" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This lead has an existing customer linked, please set New to Bank as No.
